chapter: Leaving the band, Strayhorn and reflections
title: Whether Hawkins, Eldridge or Louis sat in with the band
summary: Greer says no guest stars sat in with the band.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Oh, I know what I wanted to ask you. Did you remember any occasions on which say like Coleman Hawkins, Roy Eldridge, Louis Armstrong sat in with the band?

With our band? No. No. Hawk never played with our band. Louis -- Pops -- did Pops ever play with our band? He may have. He may have accompanied on something special, an occasion. Because him and Duke and all us were close, dear friends. But I mean actually -- you mean sit in? No.
Not work with the band, I don't mean work. I mean like just on a given -- just like what you said right now.
